methylation.feature_universe: intersection of exact C1 22,601 probe carrier with source matrix; require finite beta in all 8 HCI-005 samples
methylation.manipulation_statistic: median across retained C1 probes of mean(Decitabine beta)-mean(Vehicle beta)
methylation.treatment_null: all 70 assignments of 4 of 8 multiomic replicate identities to Decitabine; one-sided p for statistic <= observed
methylation.support_rule: observed median delta < 0 and exact p <= 0.05

rna.identifier_map: strip Ensembl version if present; map Ensembl gene ID to GENCODE v33 gene_name
rna.duplicate_symbol_rule: sum raw counts over Ensembl gene IDs mapping to the same gene symbol
rna.size_factor_rule: DESeq-style median ratio using symbols with finite strictly positive counts in all 8 samples

promoter_gene.methylation_gene_object: for each frozen promoter-core gene, per sample median beta across retained mapped C1 promoter probes; gene delta = mean Decitabine - mean Vehicle
promoter_gene.analysis_genes: genes with GENCODE-mapped RNA and at least one retained promoter-core C1 probe; no outcome filtering

coupling.primary_statistic: Spearman rho across analysis genes between promoter methylation gene delta and RNA gene delta
coupling.identity_null: B=9999 deterministic RNA gene-label permutations; one-sided p for rho <= observed
coupling.treatment_null: all 70 synchronous treatment-label assignments across the eight matched multiomic replicate identities; recompute both gene-delta vectors and rho; one-sided p for rho <= observed
coupling.support_rule: rho < 0, identity-null p <= 0.05, treatment-null p <= 0.05, and methylation manipulation support passes

claim_ceiling: intervention-consistent gene-matched promoter demethylation/RNA coupling in one HCI-005 decitabine-treated breast-cancer PDX model; not proof of local causal regulation for each gene, not a pan-cancer causal law, and does not erase the negative SCC25 temporal-direction result
